MOD = 1000000007

def compute_power(base, exponent):
    if exponent == 0:
        return 1
    half = compute_power(base, exponent // 2)
    result = (half * half) % MOD
    if exponent % 2 == 1:
        result = (result * base) % MOD
    return result

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    q = k
    if k == 0:
        print(compute_power(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(compute_power(p, p))
        return
    n = 1
    while q != 1:
        q = (q * k) % p
        n += 1
    print(compute_power(p, (p - 1) // n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
